title: family_release
description: Start a release on each listed child device (“1 hour longer now”): kind bedtime (needs kids_quiet_hours not fixed), pause (ends running pauses; needs kids_rate_limit not fixed), entity (one entity despite blocked type/bedtime; needs the blocking rule not fixed; never lock/alarm_control_panel or an entity blocked in kids_exceptions). A new release of the same kind (and entity) replaces the running one. Family manager devices only (effective rule family_manager); otherwise family_error {not_permitted}. Also accepted through the integration relay (POST /api/integration/family) when the device is away. Answer: family_result.

request_id.description: Optional id of the app, echoed in the answer.

client_ids.description: Child devices (e.g. all devices of one child). Each is checked on its own (family_result.results).
